profile.subtitleJa: 11章22節に名が記されています。
profile.summaryJa: エホヤダの子ベナヤは、カブツェエル出身の勇士の子として記され、モアブ人アリエルの二人の子を討ち、雪の日に穴の中の獅子も倒したとあります。
profile.identityNoteJa: 同名者が複数います。ここではエホヤダの子で、ケブツェエル出身とされるベナヤを指します。

facts.textJa: 本文はベナヤがこれらの働きをし、三勇士の中で名を得たと記します。
ベナヤはケレテ人とペレテ人を率いる者として記されます。
軍の第三月の隊長として再び名が挙がります。
30人の勇士を率いる者とされ、分隊にはその子アミザバドがいました。

primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, the son of a valiant man of Kabzeel, who had done mighty deeds, killed the two sons of Ariel of Moab. He also went down and killed a lion in the middle of a pit on a snowy day.
Benaiah the son of Jehoiada did these things and had a name among the three mighty men.
and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and the sons of David were chief officials serving the king.
The third captain of the army for the third month was Benaiah, the son of Jehoiada the chief priest. In his division were twenty-four thousand.
This is that Benaiah who was the mighty man of the thirty and over the thirty. Of his division was Ammizabad his son.
